summary: Backend-only verification completed for PCStore admin-reply push from PCAdmin support tickets using fully mocked integrations. Added targeted tests for helper payload/security behavior, non-200/network failure handling, and post-save execution ordering.
action_items: No functional defect found in requested PCStore admin-reply push scope.
MOCKED: PCStore admin-reply push and managed email delivery were mocked; no live external service was called.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is very large (>5k lines), which increases regression risk; split support-ticket/PCStore sync logic into focused modules.
FastAPI startup/shutdown uses deprecated on_event hooks (warnings seen in test run); migrate to lifespan handlers to avoid future breakage.
seed_data_creation: Regression test creates temporary support ticket/message fixtures in Mongo and cleans them in finally blocks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Added coverage for: encoded ticket path + exact JSON body timestamp ending Z, non-200 return false, network error swallowed with no secret leakage in logs, plural admin replies route executes send_managed_email then Mongo update then best-effort PCStore push, and singular sync endpoint still returns email_sent=false. All external integrations remained mocked.
rca of the issue: No defect reproduced in this requested scope. The implementation behavior matched the contract: best-effort PCStore sync does not block saved admin reply flow on failure paths.
